<!-- pr-reviewer: c80c188f4ee869b50569f12e4fec60ff0dd8127c -->

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

This PR adds tests only. The diff against `main` changes four test files and one decision file. No product code changes. `assets/posts/fanuc-lathe.cps` does not change, and no golden changes. This matches what issue #1842 asks for.

**What looks good**

- The fixture move from `lathe_post_g76_schedule.rs` to `tests/common/g76.rs` keeps the meaning of the code. The seven test names are the same before and after the move.
- The move had a real reason: the schedule file was 398 lines, at the 400-line limit. It is now 207 lines.
- The three new tests pin one settled reading each. They check the flank start shift, the end point D, and the clamp on the cut of one pass. The clamp test also proves that the other reading gives a different ladder on this fixture.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/1842-g76-schedule-sources.md` names the sources, the readings, and what was dropped. Reading 4 (internal rounding) stays open on #1842. The PR uses `Refs #1842`, so the issue stays open. That is correct.
- The body is complete: a conventional subject, `Changelog: none`, and the Effort line.

**Results** (built locally, Windows; the head trial-merges cleanly with `origin/main`)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `lathe_post_g76_schedule` suite | 7 passed, 0 failed |
| `lathe_post_g76_sources` suite | 3 passed, 0 failed |
| `each_pass_starts_on_the_crest_flank_line_along_the_travel` | passed |
| `every_pass_runs_to_the_posted_end_z_inside_the_root_pass` | passed |
| `the_minimum_depth_clamps_the_cut_of_one_pass` | passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| Trial merge with `origin/main` | clean, no conflicts |

The clippy run settles the open item in the PR body. The other app test binaries compile `common/g76.rs` without warnings. The `#![allow(dead_code)]` line in `common/mod.rs` covers the shared surface.

**Law check**

- No `#[ignore]` was added. No assertion was removed. The test count grew from 7 to 10.
- No new dependency between crates. No snapshot PNG and no golden change.
- The new test file sits in `crates/app/tests`, imports app items, and names its Gate map. Placement is correct.
- The fixture and the tests cite published manuals for behaviour only. That is allowed reference material.

**Notes (not blocking)**

- No Fanuc control or simulator ran these readings. The body and the decision file state this. Reading 4 needs a control run before it has an answer.
- This review is a comment only. The PR is a draft; the review does not change that state.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
